preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The length of the name must be between 1 and 9 characters.

postconditions.description: The matrix must be square, with the number of rows equal to the number of columns.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(char, str) for char in row) for row in matrixfy(name))
postconditions.description: Each row in the matrix must be a list of strings.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(matrixfy(name)[0]) for row in matrixfy(name))
postconditions.description: Each row in the matrix must have the same length as the number of rows.

postconditions.expression: matrixfy(name) == [list(name[i] if i < len(name) else '.' for i in range(len(matrixfy(name)))) for j in range(len(matrixfy(name)))]
postconditions.description: The matrix must be constructed by taking each character from the name and padding with periods if necessary to fill the matrix.
